name: computer-use
description: Last-resort control for Windows desktop applications.

interface.longDescription: Use when dedicated tools, file tools, app connectors, or browser tools cannot complete the task. Window observations provide single-use state tokens; UI Automation controls are preferred, with mouse and keyboard input as a fallback. Yields to user activity, restores the pointer after mouse actions, and stops stale or repeated actions.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current desktop and describe what is visible
Open an app and complete this task

zh.shortDescription: Windows 桌面控制（兜底工具）
zh.longDescription: 仅在专用工具、文件工具、应用连接器或浏览器工具无法完成任务时使用。窗口观测会生成一次性状态令牌，并优先通过 UI Automation 语义操作控件；物理键鼠仅作为兜底。检测到用户操作时主动让行，鼠标动作后安全复位，并对陈旧状态与重复动作循环自动熔断。
defaultPrompt: 查看当前桌面并说明可见内容
打开应用并完成这个操作
